newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Tuesday, as distant months were pressured by large-lot selling after gaining during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.2 yen per kg lower to 1.1 yen firmer than the day"s close. Benchmark July was off 1.2 yen at 160.0 yen. Volume was 8,384 lots.
Prices had edged up later in the day as the yen"s weaker tendency against the dollar and price rises in other commodity futures encouraged local investors to buy, traders said.
